description: Instructions for content operations gallery commands with parameter variants (tables, cover pages, headers/footers, page numbers, shapes, text boxes, symbols, equations, bibliography, and TOC).

SymbolInsertGallery.copyright: Insert the Copyright symbol (©) after the word 'TARGET'.
SymbolInsertGallery.registered: Insert the Registered symbol (®) after the word 'TARGET'.
SymbolInsertGallery.trademark: Insert the Trademark symbol (™) after the word 'TARGET'.
SymbolInsertGallery.degree: Insert the Degree symbol (°) after the word 'TARGET'.

TableInsertGallery.3x5: Insert a table with 3 rows and 5 columns.
TableInsertGallery.5x3: Insert a table with 5 rows and 3 columns.

TextBoxInsertGallery.whisp_quote: Insert the text box with 'Whisp Quote' style ("Gradient fill pull quote")
TextBoxInsertGallery.whisp_sidebar: Insert the text box with 'Whisp Sidebar' style ("Left-aligned sidebar with Whisp accent gradient fill")
TextBoxInsertGallery.viewmaster_quote_dark: Insert the text box with 'ViewMaster Quote (Dark)' style ("Solid fill with reverse text block and citation")
TextBoxInsertGallery.viewmaster_quote_light: Insert the text box with 'ViewMaster Quote (Light)' style ("Bordered text block with accent bar")

HeaderInsertGallery.austin: Add a header in the Austin layout ("Header with a simple page border") and replace the default header fields with Title = "Quarterly Business Review".
HeaderInsertGallery.filigree: Add a header in the Filigree layout ("Title and author name") and replace the default header fields with Title = "Quarterly Business Review" and Author = "Megan Bowen".
HeaderInsertGallery.grid: Add a header in the Grid layout ("A simple header with document title and date on opposite margins") and replace the default header fields with Title = "Quarterly Business Review" and Date = "2026-03-25".
HeaderInsertGallery.whisp: Add a header in the Whisp layout ("Right-aligned author name and date with center-aligned document title") and replace the default header fields with Author = "Megan Bowen", Date = "2026-03-25", and Title = "Quarterly Business Review".
HeaderInsertGallery.viewmaster: Add a header in the ViewMaster layout ("Right aligned document title") and replace the default header fields with Title = "Quarterly Business Review".
HeaderInsertGallery.slice_2: Add a header in the Slice 2 layout ("Page number and slice accent graphic").
HeaderInsertGallery._blank_three_columns: Add a header in the  Blank (Three Columns) layout ("Blank header set up for left, right, and center alignment").

FooterInsertGallery.austin: Add a footer in the Austin layout ("Simple footer with a page border").
FooterInsertGallery.banded: Add a footer in the Banded layout ("Centered page number in coordinating theme color").
FooterInsertGallery.ion_light: Add a footer in the Ion (Light) layout ("Simple footer with document title and author name") and replace the default footer fields with Title = "Quarterly Business Review" and Author = "Megan Bowen".
FooterInsertGallery.whisp: Add a footer in the Whisp layout ("Right-aligned page number").
FooterInsertGallery.facet_even_page: Add a footer in the Facet (Even Page) layout ("Author name and school; ideal for use in even pages of a document with book layout") and replace the default footer fields with Author = "Megan Bowen" and School = "Contoso University".
FooterInsertGallery.facet_odd_page: Add a footer in the Facet (Odd Page) layout ("Document title and subtitle; ideal for use in odd pages of a document with book layout") and replace the default footer fields with Title = "Quarterly Business Review" and Subtitle = "Strategic Planning Summary".
FooterInsertGallery._blank_three_columns: Add a footer in the  Blank (Three Columns) layout ("Blank footer set up for left, right, and center alignment").
FooterInsertGallery.grid: Add a footer in the Grid layout ("Right-aligned footer with page number and total number of pages").

CoverPageInsertGallery.austin: Insert a cover page in the Austin layout ("Title with a abstract in a block set against a styled background") and replace the default fields with Author = "Megan Bowen", Abstract = "A brief summary of the quarterly business review and strategic initiatives.", Title = "Quarterly Business Review", and Subtitle = "Strategic Planning Summary".
CoverPageInsertGallery.banded: Insert a cover page in the Banded layout ("Bold color bands with large title and reverse contact info text") and replace the default fields with Author = "Megan Bowen", Company = "Contoso Ltd.", Address = "123 Main Street, Redmond, WA 98052", and Title = "Quarterly Business Review".
CoverPageInsertGallery.facet: Insert a cover page in the Facet layout ("Geometric graphic accent with title block, document abstract, and contact info") and replace the default fields with Author = "Megan Bowen", Email = "megan@contoso.com", Title = "Quarterly Business Review", Subtitle = "Strategic Planning Summary", and Abstract = "A brief summary of the quarterly business review and strategic initiatives.".
CoverPageInsertGallery.filigree: Insert a cover page in the Filigree layout ("Large title block with Filigree ornament accents") and replace the default fields with Title = "Quarterly Business Review", Subtitle = "Strategic Planning Summary", Date = "2026-03-25", Company = "Contoso Ltd.", and Address = "123 Main Street, Redmond, WA 98052".
CoverPageInsertGallery.grid: Insert a cover page in the Grid layout ("Title Block and Abstract in a large block accented by a darker block with subtitle") and replace the default fields with Title = "Quarterly Business Review", Abstract = "A brief summary of the quarterly business review and strategic initiatives.", and Subtitle = "Strategic Planning Summary".
CoverPageInsertGallery.integral: Insert a cover page in the Integral layout ("Large photo with title block beside abstract and contact info") and replace the default fields with Title = "Quarterly Business Review", Subtitle = "Strategic Planning Summary", Abstract = "A brief summary of the quarterly business review and strategic initiatives.", Author = "Megan Bowen", and Course = "Business Strategy 101".
CoverPageInsertGallery.ion_dark: Insert a cover page in the Ion (Dark) layout ("Title block on abstract graphic coordinates with theme fills. Includes accent tab and contact info") and replace the default fields with Title = "Quarterly Business Review", Year = "2026", Subtitle = "Strategic Planning Summary", Author = "Megan Bowen", Company = "Contoso Ltd.", and Address = "123 Main Street, Redmond, WA 98052".
CoverPageInsertGallery.viewmaster: Insert a cover page in the ViewMaster layout ("Solid fill reverse cover page with accent bar, title block and contact info") and replace the default fields with Title = "Quarterly Business Review", Subtitle = "Strategic Planning Summary", Author = "Megan Bowen", Company = "Contoso Ltd.", and Address = "123 Main Street, Redmond, WA 98052".

QuickTablesInsertGallery.double_table_: Insert the 'Double Table ' quick table ("Three-column table with data doubled up to save space; uses the Light List table style").
QuickTablesInsertGallery.tabular_list: Insert the 'Tabular List' quick table ("Simple tabular list using the Light List - Accent 3 table style").
QuickTablesInsertGallery.matrix: Insert the 'Matrix' quick table ("Evenly spaced matrix, using em dashes to indicate invalid states; uses the Medium List 2 - Accent 1 table style").
QuickTablesInsertGallery.with_subheads_1: Insert the 'With Subheads 1' quick table ("Table with subheads using the Light Shading - Accent 1  table style").

BibliographyGallery.bibliography: Insert a 'Bibliography' section ("Automatic bibliography that includes all sources associated with the document") using the citation sources in the document.
BibliographyGallery.works_cited: Insert a 'Works Cited' section ("Automatic bibliography (labeled “Works Cited”) that includes all sources associated with the document") using the citation sources in the document.
BibliographyGallery.references: Insert a 'References' section ("Automatic bibliography (labeled “References”) that includes all sources associated with the document") using the citation sources in the document.

BibliographyStyle.apa: Change the document's bibliography citation style to APA and update the rendered bibliography to reflect the new style.
BibliographyStyle.mla: Change the document's bibliography citation style to MLA and update the rendered bibliography to reflect the new style.
BibliographyStyle.ieee: Change the document's bibliography citation style to IEEE and update the rendered bibliography to reflect the new style.

CitationInsert.smith2020: At the beginning of the document body, insert an in-text citation using the existing source tagged 'Smith2020'.

InsertBuildingBlocksEquationsGallery.area_of_circle: Insert the 'Area of Circle' equation (A=πr²) from the Equations gallery.
InsertBuildingBlocksEquationsGallery.pythagorean_theorem: Insert the 'Pythagorean Theorem' equation (a²+b²=c²) from the Equations gallery.

TableOfContentsGallery.automatic_table_1: Insert table of contents with 'Automatic Table 1' style ("Automatic table contents (labeled “Contents”) that includes all text formatted with the Heading 1-3 styles").
TableOfContentsGallery.automatic_table_2: Insert table of contents with 'Automatic Table 2' style ("Automatic table contents (labeled “Table of Contents”) that includes all text formatted with the Heading 1-3 styles").
TableOfContentsGallery.manual_table: Insert table of contents with 'Manual Table' style ("Manual table of contents that you can fill out independently of the document content").

PageNumbersInHeaderInsertGallery.accent_bar_1: Insert page number in header with 'Accent Bar 1' style ("Number with “Page” label and accent bar").
PageNumbersInHeaderInsertGallery.bold_numbers_1: Insert page number in header with 'Bold Numbers 1' style ("Bold page number and total number of pages").
PageNumbersInHeaderInsertGallery.brackets_1: Insert page number in header with 'Brackets 1' style ("Centered number enclosed in square brackets").
PageNumbersInHeaderInsertGallery.circle: Insert page number in header with 'Circle' style ("Number inside shaded circle").

PageNambersInFooterInsertGallery.accent_bar_1: Insert page number in footer with 'Accent Bar 1' style ("Number with “Page” label and accent bar").
PageNambersInFooterInsertGallery.bold_numbers_1: Insert page number in footer with 'Bold Numbers 1' style ("Bold page number and total number of pages").
PageNambersInFooterInsertGallery.brackets_1: Insert page number in footer with 'Brackets 1' style ("Centered number enclosed in square brackets").
PageNambersInFooterInsertGallery.circle: Insert page number in footer with 'Circle' style ("Number inside shaded circle").

PageNambersInMarginsInsertGallery.accent_bar_left: Insert page number in the left margin as a graphic element with 'Accent Bar, Left' style ("Number with “Page” label and accent bar in the left margin").
PageNambersInMarginsInsertGallery.arrow_right: Insert page number in the right margin as a graphic element with 'Arrow, Right' style ("Number inside accent arrow in the right margin").
PageNambersInMarginsInsertGallery.vertical_left: Insert page number in the left margin as a graphic element with 'Vertical, Left' style ("Large rotated number with “Page” label in the left margin").
PageNambersInMarginsInsertGallery.vertical_right: Insert page number in the right margin as a graphic element with 'Vertical, Right' style ("Large, rotated number with “Page” label in the right margin").

PageNumberFieldInsertGallery.accent_bar_1: Insert page number with 'Accent Bar 1' style at the beginning of the document body ("Number with “Page” label and accent bar").
PageNumberFieldInsertGallery.bold_numbers: Insert page number with 'Bold Numbers' style at the beginning of the document body ("Bold page number and total number of pages").
PageNumberFieldInsertGallery.plain_number: Insert page number with 'Plain Number' style at the beginning of the document body ("Number with no formatting or accents").
PageNumberFieldInsertGallery.tildes: Insert page number with 'Tildes' style at the beginning of the document body ("Number between accent tildes").

TableOfContentsAddTextGallery.level_1: Add "Alpha TARGET Omega." to the Table of Contents as Level 1.
TableOfContentsAddTextGallery.level_2: Add "Alpha TARGET Omega." to the Table of Contents as Level 2.
TableOfContentsAddTextGallery.level_3: Add "Alpha TARGET Omega." to the Table of Contents as Level 3.
